effects.printed_clause: Discard this card; send a Wicked Puppeteer card from Deck to GY. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition discards handler as cost, then sends one set-matching card from Deck; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Filtered archetype card movement from Deck to GY.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this from GY; Ritual Summon Orchis from hand/GY by Tributing hand/field Levels totaling at least 4. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GY ignition banishes itself, selects Orchis in hand/GY, validates Ritual materials and zone release, releases total Levels >= its Level 4, Ritual Summons and completes procedure; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Ritual Summons from hand or GY with custom material-total validation and CompleteProcedure.

coverage_override.reason: The discard/send effect and the GY banish/Ritual Summon effect are the two distinct effects; their separate HOPT limits are included in those records.
